svg.title: Whether a medicine is worth it in pregnancy or breastfeeding: in pregnancy most drugs are probably safe and the untreated disease is weighed against the drug, while a few major teratogens are switched or counselled on; in breastfeeding most drugs are safe if the relative infant dose is under 10 percent, a short list is contraindicated, and alcohol, tobacco, coffee and cannabis each have their own rule
